## Definition of Done

- [ ] Every acceptance criterion is met, including the failure paths
- [ ] Tests added, named after the acceptance criteria they verify
- [ ] Pipeline green, coverage gate passed
- [ ] Row added to the traceability matrix
- [ ] C4 diagrams updated if a component or container changed
- [ ] README updated if setup or run steps changed
- [ ] I can explain every line of this change, including anything AI-generated
